title: Mr Dinosaur Is Lost
hook: George 最爱的玩具恐龙先生不见了，Peppa 第一次当侦探，要把它找回来。

cells.q: What did George like to do?
cells.a: He liked to scare Peppa with Mr. Dinosaur.
cells.cn: 他喜欢用恐龙先生吓 Peppa。

cells.q: Where did Mr. Dinosaur sit at suppertime?
Did George take Mr. Dinosaur to the bath?
cells.a: Yes. He shared his bath with him.
cells.cn: 是的，他和恐龙先生一起洗澡。

cells.a: He threw Mr. Dinosaur up in the air.
cells.cn: 他把恐龙先生往天上扔。

cells.a: He was sad and cried. He lost Mr. Dinosaur.
cells.cn: 他很难过，哭了起来——恐龙先生丢了。

cells.a: Peppa was. She said, “I will help you find him.”
cells.cn: 是 Peppa。她说要帮弟弟找到它。

cells.q: Was Mr. Dinosaur in the bath?
cells.a: No. He was not in the bath.

cells.q: Where did they find Mr. Dinosaur?
cells.a: They found him high up in the tree.
cells.cn: 他们发现他高高地挂在树上。
